frontendLead: Handled operational tasks: creating, assigning, and prioritizing tasks for the frontend development team.
Conducted task reviews and deployments for the team.
Made architectural and technology stack decisions for projects.
Created a CMS and website for an agricultural holding.
Migrated the CMS project from Next 14 Pages Router to Next 15 App Router, and from Redux to Zustand. Implemented SSR, “use client,” and server-side data fetching.
Improved the CMS project’s linter. Introduced Prettier and automated code style enforcement. Integrated packages for collaboration: simple-git-hooks, lint-staged, and commitlint.
Designed the CMS interface without a design file, considering component libraries. Assisted the team in interface planning.
Refined critical modules (authentication, etc.) and launched the CMS project.
Built the agricultural holding’s website from scratch using technologies new to the team.
Implemented Tailwind for layout and Framer Motion for animated sections on the website.
Created a component base for the agricultural holding’s website.
Applied the PixelPerfect principle to the agricultural holding’s website.
design: Refined designs within the team during the development process.

15web.dismissal: Project completion. Work on the CMS and the website for the agricultural holding was finished.

about.title: General
about.description: I have been working in design since 2009, creating layouts for newspapers and books. Since 2011, I have been involved in commercial design, working in publishing houses and printing companies. Since 2014, I have been focusing on digital product design, layout, and frontend development. In teams, I represent two competencies: designer and frontend developer.

design.title: Design
design.description: Prototyping interfaces based on hypotheses and user experience analysis. Generating hypotheses based on user data from analytics services. Designing interaction scenarios between users and the product. Creating and maintaining a component library and design tokens as part of the design system. Writing interface texts in an informative style, aligned with the product’s tone of voice.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.description: Development and maintenance of: product interfaces, client-side logic, API interactions, component libraries, and npm packages.

html.title: Markup development
html.description: HTML5, semantic markup, CSS, Less, SCSS, PostCSS, TailwindCSS. BEM, Mobile-first, responsive and cross-browser layout. Basic animation.

dev.title: Development
dev.description: Working with Jamstack. Setting up and integrating a Headless CMS into the project. Configuring infrastructure for local development and deploying the project on a VPS in Docker. Setting up internal and external routing, including SSL. Configuring CI/CD and building the project. SEO analysis and project optimization.

1.title: 1. Awareness
1.description: Understanding how a specialist works in this field, what tasks they perform, their workflow and tools, methods and practices, what peculiarities and limitations are imposed on them.

2.title: 2. Skill
2.description: The ability to solve basic tasks in the field, such as completing less critical parts of work under the guidance of a lead specialist, assembling a layout or prototype based on existing materials, making meaningful improvements to an existing document, etc.

3.title: 3. Expertise
3.description: Performing most tasks in the field of knowledge from start to finish, often independently. Ability to handle atypical situations.

4.title: 4. Leadership
4.description: The ability to transfer expertise to other team members, assist in training and professional growth of colleagues, develop tools and methods, and enhance overall culture. The opportunity to identify problematic situations in the project or process and assist in their resolution.
